title: Prove sharp even-difference image maxima and the small exception (no κ)
body:
**The binary matching image bound is sharp for every positive even k−nu, with one small exception.** For an irreducible collection of rank-one idempotents with nonzero off-patterns, let k be its actual pattern dimension, nu the matching number of its matrix-unit graph, and n its joint-image dimension. The exact maximum is `(3k+nu−2)/2`, except at `(k,nu)=(2,0)`, where it is **one**.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/verify.py) and [source credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/CREDITS.md).

Two fresh links to the disjoint pair/triple core attain every regular case. Their complete pools have n members, except at `(k,nu,n)=(4,0,5)`, where an additional lift gives six members. The proof includes that member. A two-dimensional restriction argument excludes n=2 in the small exception, and a complete one-dimensional pool attains its maximum. At k=nu, only k=1 permits an irreducible collection, as a proper subcollection of its pool. Together with the prior sharp odd case, this gives all fixed-(k,nu) maxima and existence cases. The dimension-five instance was already attained by a different five-member pool in [PR #7094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7094), credited below. It does not classify every maximizing pool or a prescribed edge graph.

**No new kappa.** Image capacity supplies no legal paid word, relation lattice, native implementation, owned storage, restoration or complete signed recursive invoice. The selected value remains `363005817/100000000000` and all five assumptions remain. The existing single-bridge word obstruction does not automatically cover this two-link alphabet.

Canonical base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Card `bit-helper-contract` changes scope to the remaining geometric maximum; the [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19710038) states its relevance and stop rule. Current main, live handoffs, open/closed PR overlap and the exact predecessor heads were checked. Sparse local and unpublished work remain overlap limits. Only the new package is changed.

With CPython 3.12 and no third-party dependency:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/edge-matching-even-attainment
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/edge-matching-even-attainment/verify.py
```

Expected direct marker:

```text
PASS_EDGE_MATCHING_EVEN_ATTAINMENT
```

Both registered modes pass. All 42256 nonzero patterns in 24 attaining fixtures are lifted, with exact complete-pool, rank, matching, Gram and connectivity checks. Every nonzero-vector orbit is checked when n≤9. Raw factor scans independently reconstruct the four smaller family pools and the exceptional witness. All 36 ordered pairs and 216 ordered triples on F2² are checked; every pair and the 168 triples with idempotent sum have an invariant line. All 126 one-per-edge choices through k=6 are checked. Wrong-parity links and idempotent links with connected action but a common kernel provide failure controls. The prior five-member pool is also checked as a prior-result comparison, including all its patterns and nonzero-vector orbits.

The all-width result uses the written proof and the cited matching upper bound; the finite checks are corroboration. Syntax and indentation, committed bytes/modes, source history, export input coverage and optimized sealed Git-free replay pass. Sealed source hashes and read-only modes remain unchanged. [Validation details](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/VALIDATION.md) list the domains and limits. Complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, native, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal-kernel review were not run. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44320486978/job/134857787041) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Credit Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, for the consumed [PR #7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692) [matching theorem](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a/research/edge-matching-image-bound/PROOF.md), head `c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a`, and [PR #7703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7703) [odd-difference proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2523029b27d40526b811591ce0fb85f9bc1b1df7/research/edge-matching-equality-classification/PROOF.md), head `2523029b27d40526b811591ce0fb85f9bc1b1df7`. The latter's [binary primitives and old-core constructor](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2523029b27d40526b811591ce0fb85f9bc1b1df7/research/edge-matching-equality-classification/verify.py) are adapted here. Its odd maxima are prior results, not recounted as new.

Credit Nick Petalas (@petalas) for [PR #6785](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6785), head `5dbf2c05220bea53d84b510efe5910c4cec8f182`: its [one-edge proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5dbf2c05220bea53d84b510efe5910c4cec8f182/research/one-edge-pattern-reducibility/PROOF.md) gives the upper bound four at (3,1) and leaves attainment open. The new family attains it. The linked credits retain the earlier fiber and normal-triple contributors. Credit @unpaidmoon for [PR #7094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7094), head `b5f0a0df3d22e8ad40d67d6be4d1c7ff24d180c5`: its [proof](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b5f0a0df3d22e8ad40d67d6be4d1c7ff24d180c5/research/no-edge-dim4-image-five/PROOF.md) already attains (4,0,5) with five members and discloses substantial Cursor Grok assistance. That instance and the earlier matching upper bound already give its maximum. The new six-member fixture does not claim first attainment. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

[Open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/README.md): classify all even maximizers, or give a legal full-endpoint word on the new alphabet with a complete bill. Neither follows from the maximum theorem, and neither is reserved.
